title: Daily Training
tickModelDone: Today's training has already run. Changes to focus or intensity now take effect at the next training (tomorrow). Form and fatigue update only at the daily training, not continuously.
disabledNote: Daily training is currently paused. Training programs can still be set up now.
noRiders: No riders on your squad yet.
bulkPartial: Updated {applied} of {total}. {failed} could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
bulkSmartSkippedHasPlan: {n, plural, one {Skipped # rider with an existing plan.} other {Skipped # riders with an existing plan.}}

assistantSuggestions.title: Assistant suggestions
assistantSuggestions.intro: The assistant suggests a training focus for your riders. Review them below, then accept all or only the ones you want.
assistantSuggestions.allHavePlanNote: Every rider shown already has your own plan, and the assistant never changes those. Clear a rider's focus to let it take over.
assistantSuggestions.nothingAppliedYet: Nothing is applied until you accept.
assistantSuggestions.empty: No suggestions right now. Every rider already has a matched focus.
assistantSuggestions.emptyFiltered: Every rider already has a plan.

historySubtitle: Your last 30 days of daily training
historyEmpty: No training runs yet. Once daily training is live, each day's run will be logged here.
riderHistorySubtitle: This rider's daily training over the last 30 days
riderHistoryEmpty: No training history for this rider yet.
weekRhythmIntro: One target intensity per weekday for the whole squad. It is only the default: a rider's own day, or his own weekly plan, always wins.
weekRhythmReset: Weekly rhythm removed: riders are back to their season intensity every day.
weekRhythmSaveFailed: Could not save. Try again in a moment.
planActionErrorGeneric: Could not save. Try again in a moment.
planActionError_not_own_rider: You can only train your own riders.
planActionError_auth: Your session expired. Sign in again.
planActionError_network: Connection failed. Check your network and try again.
weekRhythmTodayHintPlan: today: {intensity} (this rider's own setting, overrides team rhythm)
raceDayTooltip: {riderName} rides {raceName} today. The race replaces the planned session and develops the abilities the race demands. Your plan is unchanged and applies again tomorrow.

receipt.title: This season
receipt.nowTooltip: The rider's current value, not the ceiling. Check the bar or the "done" tag to see if there's more to gain.
receipt.doneTitle: This ability is fully developed. Training develops this rider's other abilities instead.
receipt.note: Whole points gained since the season started. A gold dot marks the abilities the current focus trains.
receipt.pending: Season totals appear once the active season is loaded.
receipt.notStarted: The season starts {date}. Season totals begin then, and training before that still counts toward the next point.
receipt.noDaysYet: No training days in this season yet. Season totals start after the first day of training, and every point already earned stays in the bars.
receipt.yesterdayContribution: {pct}% of this bar came from yesterday's session.

yesterdayPointsLanded: {n, plural, =0 {no points landed} one {# point landed} other {# points landed}}

yesterdayLine.restFresh: Rest day. Fresh again, fatigue {from} to {to}.

individualWeekPlanRemoved: Individual weekly plan removed: rider follows the team rhythm again.
individualWeekPlanBadgeTitle: This rider has their own individual weekly plan, which overrides the team's weekly rhythm.
momentBreakthrough_1: {riderName} finds another gear in {ability}, up to {to} now.
momentBreakthrough_2: A real step forward for {riderName} today, {ability} climbs to {to}.
momentNearBreakthrough_0: {riderName} is closing in on a breakthrough in {ability}, {pct}% of the way there.
momentNearBreakthrough_1: One more good session and {riderName} bumps {ability} up a level, already {pct}% there.
momentNearBreakthrough_2: {riderName}'s {ability} is on the edge of the next step, {pct}% through the block.
momentNearBreakthrough_3: Watch {riderName}: {ability} is nearly ready to tick over, {pct}% logged.
momentPeakForm_0: {riderName} is riding sharp form right now, primed for the next big day.
momentPeakForm_1: {riderName} is in peak form today, timing looks good for what's coming.
momentPeakForm_2: Form is reading strong for {riderName}, this is the shape to race in.
momentPeakForm_3: {riderName} is flying in training right now, form near its best.
momentSharpDay_0: {riderName} had a sharp day on the bike, above expectation.
momentSharpDay_1: A strong session for {riderName} today, output beat the plan.
momentSharpDay_2: {riderName} answered the day's training well, a sharp one.
momentSharpDay_3: Good numbers from {riderName} today, a clearly sharp session.
momentQuiet_0: Quiet day on the training log: {trained} riders out, base miles banked, no headline gains yet.
momentQuiet_1: Nothing dramatic today, {trained} riders trained and the work goes into the log.
momentQuiet_2: A steady block for the squad: {trained} on the bike, gains building quietly underneath.
momentQuiet_3: No standout story today, just {trained} riders putting in the miles.
momentRest_0: Recovery day across the roster: no sessions logged, legs get the rest instead.
momentRest_1: Full rest for the squad today, tomorrow's training starts from fresher legs.
momentRest_2: Quiet at the training base today: everyone's on a rest day.
momentRest_3: The whole roster took it easy today, recovery over output.

focus.title: Pick what each rider trains
focus.body: The focus decides which abilities grow fastest. Match it to the rider's type: a focus his type is weak in barely moves, no matter the intensity. Leave it blank and your assistant picks one that fits.

runToday.title: Train once a day
runToday.body: Press this and the squad trains with a +25% bonus on the day's gains. Skip it and your assistant runs the session after 22:00 without the bonus. Hard intensity gains more but leaves riders tired for their next race.

nextUp.title: Read the week at a glance
nextUp.body: The strip is the rider's next seven days: the darker the block, the harder the day, a dashed block is rest, and today is the outlined one. Click it to give this rider his own weekly plan. Progress per ability lives on the Development tab.

focusPanel.title: Focus for {name}
focusPanel.signalStrongTitle: This rider's primary or secondary type supports these abilities, so training here goes furthest and fastest.
focusPanel.signalWeakTitle: Both of this rider's types work against these abilities, so there is very little room to grow them.
focusPanel.noRisk: No risk of losing progress at any intensity
focusPanel.note: A focus develops its own abilities fastest. The rest keep improving more slowly, so a rider grows across the board, just fastest in the direction you choose.

dayPanel.title: Training day for {name}
dayPanel.dayTypeNote_rest: Fatigue drops the most. No growth.
dayPanel.dayTypeNote_recovery: Fatigue drops a little. A little growth on recovery.
dayPanel.dayTypeNote_skill: Low load. Craft only, and it builds slowly.
dayPanel.dayTypeNote_training: Physical abilities, at the level of the session.
dayPanel.noSession_rest: A rest day has no session. Your rider does not train, and his fatigue comes down faster than on any other day. Whatever session he was on is kept, so one click puts him back on it.
dayPanel.noSession_recovery: Active recovery has no session. Your rider spins easy: fatigue comes down, though less than on a full rest day, and he gains a little on recovery. It is the only day that lowers fatigue and still develops something.
dayPanel.sessionNote_vo2max: Climbing and punch at an even share.
dayPanel.sessionNote_vo2max_climb: Punch is not trained. Climbing gains more instead.
dayPanel.sessionNote_vo2max_punch: Climbing is not trained. Punch gains more instead.
dayPanel.note: A session carries its own effort, so you no longer set that separately. Skill days build craft at a fixed, slower rate, whatever the rider is built for.

noRidersHint: Draft your first rider in the live auction, then set his training day here.

overview.emptyFilteredHint: Clear the filters to see the whole squad again.
